name: postcss
description: Tool for transforming CSS with JS plugins

scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm run test:ci:parallel
scripts.test:ci:parallel: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:js && npm run build:js:types && npm run build:js:readme
scripts.build:js:types: tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir . --moduleResolution node --module commonjs --allowSyntheticDefaultImports --noImplicitAny --strict --allowJs --checkJs false --target es5 --allowUnreachableCode false --allowUnusedLabels false --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch false --noUnusedLocals false --noUnusedParameters false --skipLibCheck true --noImplicitThis false --noImplicitReturns false --noImplicitAny false --strictNullChecks false src/postcss.js
scripts.postinstall: node -e "if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') console.log('Please run `npm run build` first. See https://postcss.org/docs/installation#postinstall for more information.')"
